budget.costBasis: at most 42 document writes, 21 document deletes and a few hundred document reads across 37 requests in one run

notes: Partition queries order by __name__ only, which needs no index.
Cursor cases use single-field orders at collection scope, which automatic single-field indexes already cover.
The nonce-unique collection group must have no field override, exemption or time-to-live policy.
permissionNotes: Every compiled operation is a data-plane read, write or delete on the owned documents; none reads or changes configuration, indexes, Rules or backups.
datastore.entities.list covers RunQuery and PartitionQuery, which need database-wide read because PartitionQuery takes a database parent.
roles/datastore.user is the smallest predefined role that grants these; a custom role limited to the four permissions is smaller and sufficient.
